'''Nesan 27 (November 22)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - The [[Battle of the Shining Walls]] begins when the Grand Alliance attacks the [[Aiel]], who are laying siege to [[Tar Valon]]. [[al'Lan Mandragoran]] leads a contingent of [[Kandori]], [[Saldaean]] and [[Domani]] soldiers against the Aiel.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Egwene]], [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]], together with [[Verin]], [[Hurin]] and [[Mat]], leave to head back to Tar Valon.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Eamon Valda]] returns to [[Amador]] from Tar Valon. [[Morgase]] sees [[Paitr]] hanged, and agrees to sign a treaty allowing the [[Whitecloaks]] into [[Andor]].
